name: E2E: Requestor checks ticket status and adds information
objective: Validate the complete end-to-end journey where a user asks about their tickets, views the list, requests details for a specific ticket, and adds a comment to it.
precondition: User has valid credentials. User has an existing open incident INC-12345 in the system.

steps.description: Log in to the self-service portal and navigate to home page
steps.expectedResult: Home page loads with Agentforce icon visible

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon to open the AI Assistant

steps.testData: "What is the status of my tickets?"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant displays a list of open tickets including INC-12345

steps.description: Ask for details about a specific ticket
steps.expectedResult: Detailed status and assignment information is displayed

steps.description: Request to add information to the ticket
steps.testData: "I want to add information to INC-12345"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant prompts for the information to add

steps.testData: "The issue is now affecting 5 more users on the same floor"

steps.description: Verify the comment is saved successfully
steps.expectedResult: The assistant confirms the update was added as a customer-visible comment

steps.description: Verify the assigned fulfiller receives a notification
steps.expectedResult: Notification is sent to the assigned fulfiller about the update
